BATTLE AT THE SPRINGS
proprospec

JUN 18 - JUN 20/#FDCT/STAFFORD, CONNECTICUT, USA

View pro ResultsView prospec Results

Formula DRIFT makes its debut at Stafford Motor Speedway, bringing high-speed tandem battles and tire-smoking drifting action to the iconic Connecticut oval for the first time.

Prohibited Items

  • Coolers
  • Backpacks
  • Non personal sized bags
  • Umbrellas
  • Glass
  • Cans
  • Alcohol
  • Cannabis / Marijuana
  • Skateboards
  • Rollerblades
  • Bikes
  • Pets
  • Thermos Bottles Or Coolers
  • Soliciting
  • Firearms / Dangerous Weapons
  • Lasers
  • Scooters
  • Folding Chairs
  • Full-Size Chairs

Allowed Items

  • 1 Bag Per Person
  • 1 Gallon clear plastic freezer bag
  • Clear plastic bag less than 12″ x 12″ x 6″
  • Personal sized purses and wallets
  • Medical bags
  • Diaper bags
  • Juice Boxes
  • Plastic Bottles
  • Snacks, Etc

Grandstand and Other Rules

  • Personal chair backs are permitted with size restricted to a maximum seat depth of 12 inches
  • Folding chair and any full-size chairs are not permitted
  • Smoking Is Prohibited In The Main Grandstand Area.
  • Children ages 14 years and younger must be accompanied by a paying adult when entering and exiting the admission gates.
  • Children are not allowed to exit the facility without an adult.
  • The paddock area is restricted to persons involved in the preparation and maintenance of vehicles in competition. The paddock area is not a spectator area and persons under 14 years of age are prohibited from entering the paddock area. All 14 and 15 year olds entering the paddock area must be accompanied by a parent/guardian and must complete and sign an Addendum A form prior to entry into the paddock area.
  • Shoes And Shirts Must Be Worn at all times.
  • Flip-Flops Are Prohibited from the paddock area
  • No soliciting
